chunks: I heard Abu Jaʿfar (peace be upon him) saying:
Through us God is worshipped, and through us God is recognized, and through us God the Blessed and Exalted is declared One,
and Muhammad is a veil of God the Blessed and Exalted.

key_terms.بِنَا: through us — the Ahl al-Bayt as the necessary means of worship and divine knowledge
key_terms.تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى: Blessed and Exalted — honorific formula applied to God
key_terms.حِجَابُ: veil — the Prophet as the intermediary screen between the Divine Essence and creation
key_terms.وُحِّدَ: was declared One — passive form; tawhid is realized only through Imami mediation

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Baqir say about the role of the Ahl al-Bayt in the worship and recognition of God in al-Kafi?
ai.summary: Imam Muhammad al-Baqir (peace be upon him) asserts that the Ahl al-Bayt are the indispensable intermediaries through whom God is worshipped, known, and declared One — collapsing any notion of tawhid divorced from their authority. The declaration that the Prophet Muhammad is a 'veil' (hijab) of God signals that the Divine Essence is accessible to creation only through prophetic and Imami mediation, a cornerstone of Shia creedal theology.

en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Jamhour, from Ali Bin Al Salt, from Al Hakam and Ismail, two sone of Habeeb, from Bureyd Al Ijaly who said, 
‘I heard Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> saying:

‘Due to us<sup>azwj</sup> Allah<sup>azwj</sup> is worshipped, and due to us<sup>asws</sup> Allah<sup>azwj</sup> is recognised, and due to us<sup>asws</sup> Allah<sup>azwj</sup> the Blessed and High is regarded as One,
and Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> is a veil of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High’.
en.sarwar: 10. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Jumhur from Ali ibn al-Salt from al-Hakam and Isma‘il sons of Habid from Burayd al-‘Ijli who has said the following. “I heard Imam abu Ja‘far (a.s.) saying, ‘
Through us Allah is worshipped. Through us Allah is known. Through us belief in the Oneness of Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High, is established.
Muhammad is the Hijab (curtain) of Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High.”
